slack.name: Slack
slack.limits: Recipients must be members of our Slack workspace and must connect Slack in their profile before alerts reach them. Slack rate-limits messages (about 1 per second per channel), so bursts may be delayed.

meta_whatsapp.name: WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API)
meta_whatsapp.limits: Free-form replies are only possible within 24 hours of the customer's last message; after that a pre-approved template is required. Test numbers can only message people you add as recipients.

twilio_whatsapp.name: WhatsApp (Twilio)
twilio_whatsapp.limits: Optional alternative provider. Not available yet.

stripe.name: Stripe (test mode)
stripe.limits: Test mode only: no real money moves. Payment links expire after 24 hours.

google_calendar.name: Google Calendar
google_calendar.limits: Each employee connects their own calendar. Relay reads free/busy only to avoid double-booking and writes only the appointments it creates.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.limits: Optional. Relay works fully with AI off. Daily spend caps apply and AI never acknowledges or owns a lead.
